title: Mistake: the function that returns undefined
why_it_matters: Forgetting return is one of the most common beginner bugs.
explanation: Arrow functions with curly braces need an explicit return. Without braces, the value after the arrow is returned automatically. If a function gives you undefined, check for a missing return first.
code:
const double = (n) => { n * 2 };   // no return
const doubleOk = (n) => n * 2;     // implicit return
console.log(double(4), doubleOk(4)); // undefined 8
try_it: Write a function with braces and no return, log it, then fix it.
